rubric_items.reason: CO-1 to CO-5 are implemented as designed: one FILTER count query bound to patient_id, PatientService.get attaches visitSummary (so EP-1 to EP-3 carry it), both PatientDetail types declare it, and the block sits directly above the Appointments heading.
SQL stays in api/src/repositories and the rule in api/src/services; the query uses a bound parameter and fixed status literals; no logging was added; the unknown-id 404 path in get is unchanged.
Five files, 29 lines added and 2 deleted, all named by the design. The only extra edit is the Omit on PatientRepo.get's return type, which the new required field needs to keep compiling.
Counts go through Number() with a ?? 0 fallback, so text counts and a missing row both yield integers; notFound is thrown before visitSummary runs; no new endpoint was added.
Summary and Changes match the code I read in all five files. One small gap: the body leans on threat T-7, but threat.md is not among the artifact's inputs and the reference has no citation.

findings.text: The Summary justifies the Number() conversion with threat T-7, but threat.md is not in the artifact's inputs and no claim cites it, so the reference cannot be traced from this artifact. T-7 does exist in the run's threat.md and the code satisfies it.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the T-7 mention, or add threat.md to inputs and back the sentence with a claim that cites the T-7 item.
